mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and amitriptyline is metabolized by CYP3A4/CYP2D6 which chloroquine may inhibit, increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels and cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor ECG baseline and periodically; consider alternative antimalarial or antidepressant; avoid in patients with pre-existing QT prolongation or cardiac conduction abnormalities.
